purpose: Compare consumer-supplied before and after values with explicit change semantics and adjacent revision provenance.
useWhen: multiple fields need a readable before and after comparison
a correction, amendment, or review must keep reason, actor, time, and evidence beside the changed facts
avoidWhen: one stable fact is enough; use KeyValueList
the consumer needs immutable audit storage, correction mutation, or policy evaluation
states: changed, added, removed, or unchanged field rows
accessibility: Expose field, before, after, and explicit change text through semantic table headers and cells; never rely on color alone.
Keep reason, actor, occurred-at, and evidence or source readable in the same tab order.
Use an explicit Not present value for added or removed fields so absence is understandable to every reader.
responsive: Stack each field's label, before value, after value, and change state in narrow containers without changing meaning.
Retain shared table geometry, readable wrapping, and touch-safe spacing.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for state transitions.
